units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 46:22">Targ. Jer. XLVI, 22</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 147:18">Targ. Ps. CXLVII, 18</cite> Ms. (ed. <he>זלח׳</he>, h. text <he>יזלו</he>). [Targ. II Esth. I, 2 <he>זחלין בוסמ׳</he>, read <he>זלחין</he>, v. preced.]

senses.gloss: to let run off, to empty (by opening the spicket). Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ bot. עד דתְזַחֲלוּן גובה until ye shall have emptied the pit.
